title: Contact
content:
Talk with the jMonkeyEngine community

Choose the channel that fits your request. Use email for private conversations, the community hub for support and longer discussions, and GitHub for issues that need to be tracked.

Email Write to us privately. contact@jmonkeyengine.org Community Hub Best place for support questions, project discussions, announcements, and longer-form conversations. Open Hub Discord Quick chat with the community. Good for real-time questions and meeting other developers. Join Discord Issues and bugs Use GitHub for reproducible engine bugs, feature requests, and technical work that should be tracked. Open GitHub OpenCollective Donate directly to the main project fund, or choose one of the dedicated project funds. Donate
